query:
INSERT INTO sales_agent_conversations ("prospectId", state, "nextFollowUpAt", "lastActivityAt", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  p.id,
  'discovery',
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM prospects p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM sales_agent_conversations sac WHERE sac."prospectId" = p.id
);
